analysis.title: DeskTalk - US equity check: The clearing event
key_insights: SPX is up 1.8% and on track for its best single day in months, with the US midterm election results treated as a clearing event after a sharp overnight reversal.

The Mag 7 led the rally after Texas Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa pledged to crack down on the AI buildout and 'stop the data center takeover', which eased concerns about aggressive AI-related CapEx spending.
Hardware names are under pressure, with the SOX down nearly 3%.
Sector performance is broadly positive. Industrials and Energy are the only laggards, with oil down 10%.
Healthcare is among the top-performing sectors on expectations of expanded Medicaid subsidies under a Democratic Congress.
Citi's cash equity desk flows are skewed toward Consumer Staples. Info Technology, Financials, Consumer Discretionary and Energy are seeing net outflows.
Vol has collapsed as election-related event risk fades. Spot VIX is down roughly 20% to 17, and put skew remains contained, which suggests investors have not yet aggressively rebuilt hedges.
Arm Holdings, Qualcomm and AppLovin report after today's close.
A close above the key CTA level of 7,670 in the SPX (ESZ6, ref $7,740) would flip the index back to long and point to systematic buying flows on Thursday.
